answer: Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a pulse counter-signature, and the vine graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 19% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, entered as a forge edge. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
